results.detail: Update Joinings main.cs:124-133 catches SoapException/Exception, sets ErrorDescription and calls DirectRowToError. The Error output (sync, excl. group 1) has no path: the data flow has only 2 paths (DTSX:6498-6499), and neither leaves Update Joinings. The package therefore creates no warning or error for these rows. CRM.Proxy is correctly marked unknown. In Close Joining processes, Update to close joining.Error -> Set Warning columns 1 2 1 -> ETL Warning 1 2 1, which runs crmServiceProxy.Create of gen_etlprocesswarning with no condition (main.cs:60-76). So failures there are recorded as ETL warnings. The finding is conditional ('אם ... נכשל') and is not framed as a bug.

results.detail: Most of short_he is correct and matches ScriptMain.cs:107-134 (DTSX:4900 block): the start at DateTime.Now.AddDays(-1).Date; the skip only on an exact dt.Select("starttime = '" + currDate.ToString() + "'") match; the culture-dependent string; the 3-calendar-day result when nothing matches (trace: D-1 count 1->2, D-2 2->3, D-3 break, returns D-3); the caveat that skipping is unproven; and the use of the threshold by Get Joinings From DB. Two units are wrong. (1) flow_he[1] 'שליפת ימי שישי, שבת וחג' says the step retrieves Friday/Saturday/holiday days. It actually retrieves the starttime of CalendarRule rows whose Name is 'Friday'/'Saturday'/'Holiday' with starttime in [GetutcDate()-21, GetutcDate()] (DTSX:4090). Whether those rows are those days is exactly what short_he says is unproven, so the label contradicts the claim's own caveat. (2) short_he 'ומחזירה את השלישי (הבדיקה מוגבלת ל-21 ימים אחורה)' does not say what is returned when the cap is reached. If the loop ends without the break (fewer than 3 non-matching days among D-1..D-21), it returns currDate after 21 decrements: D-22, which is not 'the third' working day. This depends on the data, so it must be conditional.

results.detail: [2] is correct. [1] states as fact that what is fetched are 'הימים שאינם ימי עבודה (שישי, שבת וחג)'. The SQL (DTSX:4090) fetches the starttime of CalendarRule rows named Friday/Saturday/Holiday. 'Non-working days' is a meaning taken from the task and variable names (Get NonWorkingDays, User::NonWorkingDays), and whether these rows mark days is exactly what [2] and the title call unproven. The package's own detailed claim [1] words it correctly ('כללי לוח השנה בשם ...'). [3] 'יום העבודה השלישי לפני היום' is unconditional. If 3 non-matching days are not found within D-1..D-21, the result is D-22 (ScriptMain.cs:119-133).

No other writer of LastThreeWorkingDays exists in the DTSX (grep: only DTSX:42 definition, 4904 ReadWrite, 5226). The design value is 10/2/2017 5:29:05 PM (DTSX:43), and the config file may override it. [9] is wrong. results.detail: [1]-[3] and [5]-[9] are verified. [1]: precedence DTSX:6510 -> 6509 -> 6511 is all Success, and Close Joining processes sets gen_joiningstatus=8 (Set columns DTSX:1016) for status-7 rows (DTSX:980). [2]: the SQL and the ? -> Parameter0 -> {81CBF82A} = User::LastThreeWorkingDays (DTSX:5541-5549). [3]: DTSX:5573 = 12. [9]: the Error output has no path, and CRM.Proxy is unknown. Two units are wrong. [4] 'שום שדה אחר לא משתנה' is an absolute statement about the CRM record. The package writes only gen_joiningstatus (main.cs:118-122). But the CRM platform updates system fields (modifiedon/modifiedby) on every Update, and plugins/workflows are external_unknown, so the sentence is not true as written. [10] 'שתאריך gen_sendtobankdate שלהן לפני שלושה ימי עבודה או יותר' states as fact that the threshold is three working days ago. The package's own LastThreeWorkingDays claims say that skipping Friday/Saturday/holidays is unproven; if no rule matches, the threshold is 3 calendar days. So [10] contradicts them. Use 'לא מאוחר מתאריך הסף', as the detail claim does.
